added.summary: Surface layer roles after rune-kit's Kit: `layer-1` to `layer-4` (each a step further from the page, darker in light and lighter in dark), plus `hover`, `pressed`, `knob-on` and `border-muted` in both schemes; elevation shadows for `overlay`, `control` and `input`; and the `disclosure` spring. `glass`, `glass-hi`, `plate-hi`, `raised-lo` and `raised-hi` stay as aliases of the layers.

fixed.summary: Panel.frame fills with `layer-1`, Plate.frame with `layer-2` and Row.frame with `layer-3`, so a framed surface always shows its frame. The selected row (Row.frame.selected) marks itself with `layer-4` and an inset bar inside its frame instead of a leading border the frame hid.

Every status and rarity ink holds 4.5:1 on every surface layer: `xp` (and so `epic`) is lighter in dark (#de85ff), `gold` darker in light (#855500), each moved in OKLCH lightness only, and the light `accent-ink` any seed derives is a little darker.
